title: 封裝射頻遮蔽
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入RF 屏蔽導電連續性、孔縫與近場耦合；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine rf shield continuity, apertures and near-field coupling. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。遠場平面波屏蔽公式不直接涵蓋封裝近場磁耦合；材料厚度只是因素之一，孔縫、接地及共振需實測。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Far-field plane-wave shielding formulas do not directly cover package near-field magnetic coupling; thickness is only one factor alongside seams, grounding and resonance.

stages.title: 場源與耦合
stages.description: 本階段處理場源與耦合：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address sources and coupling through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 定義干擾源和受害者
steps.objective: 建立「定義干擾源和受害者」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：頻譜與敏感節點決定屏蔽需求，不是只看最高時鐘。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for define source and victim: Spectrum and sensitive nodes define shielding needs, not only maximum clock.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。畫源、耦合路徑及受害回路。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Draw source, coupling path and victim loop. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：畫源、耦合路徑及受害回路。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Draw source, coupling path and victim loop. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：金屬厚度足夠就可忽略接縫。本步先檢查「定義干擾源和受害者」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到頻譜與敏感節點決定屏蔽需求，不是只看最高時鐘。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Sufficient metal thickness makes seams irrelevant. First check whether evidence for define source and victim actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Spectrum and sensitive nodes define shielding needs, not only maximum clock.
steps.check: 交付「定義干擾源和受害者」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for define source and victim, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Draw source, coupling path and victim loop. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.

steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：所有頻率和場型都有相同屏蔽效能。本步先檢查「定義干擾源和受害者」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到頻譜與敏感節點決定屏蔽需求，不是只看最高時鐘。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: All frequencies and field types share the same shielding effectiveness. First check whether evidence for define source and victim actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Spectrum and sensitive nodes define shielding needs, not only maximum clock.
steps.check: 交付「定義干擾源和受害者」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for define source and victim: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.
